faq.q: What is AI product photo generation?
faq.a: It is an AI tool that builds realistic product images automatically, so an online store gets professional-looking photos without a traditional photoshoot.

faq.q: How does AI product photo generation work?
faq.a: You give the tool a product photo and a short description. It builds new product photos around your item, and you can change the backdrop, light and look.

faq.q: Is there a free way to make AI product photos?
faq.a: There is no free plan right now. Each image uses 24 credits, and the price shows before the job starts; the pricing page lists the planned monthly plans.

faq.q: Are AI product photos good for ecommerce?
faq.a: Yes. They are professional, consistent and affordable for storefronts, catalogs and ad campaigns, as long as you compare each result with the item you ship.

faq.q: What kinds of product photos can I make?
faq.a: White-background main shots, coastal and indoor lifestyle scenes, on-model views, close details and social ad stills. Every image starts from a photo of your product.

faq.q: What are the benefits of using AI product photos?
faq.a: Fast image creation, a consistent look, easy background changes and multiple product variations in minutes instead of days.
Downloaded images are watermark-free and licensed for commercial use on Amazon, Shopify, social feeds and ads. Start from photos you own or have permission to use.

faq.q: Can I add a price or logo to the photo?
faq.a: Type prices, offers and logos in your editor after you download, since generated lettering can come out wrong. That keeps every word and brand mark accurate.
